name: Sergeant Pup
author: Steambirds Revive
description: Four pods fly to a row behind the leader. They are not bolted on: a sudden turn makes them catch their point with their own turn and speed. The leader takes no damage until the last pod dies and shows enemyShieldZone_1, the small purple enemy bubble (tankShield is the player tank). The Alone state is the leader AI, not this file.
